**[ENERGYCODE](https://www.energycode.org/)** is a personal technical blog about
mathematics, statistics, data science and scientific computing. Posts are
written as reproducible notebooks: the R and Python code that produces every
figure, table and result is on the page, ready to copy and run.

### What you will find here

- **Number theory and integer sequences**: identities, proofs and computations
  around [OEIS](https://oeis.org) sequences, repunits, tetrahedral and Catalan
  numbers.
- **Linear algebra**: structured matrices, determinants, powers and norms.
- **Data science and statistics**: model evaluation, exploratory analysis and
  real-world datasets.
- **Scientific computing tools**: small packages and utilities in R, Python,
  PARI/GP and Mathematica, collected under [Projects](projects.qmd).

Posts are written in English or Spanish, depending on the topic.

### Feedback

Found an error, or have a question about a post? Use the **Report an issue**
link at the end of any page to open an issue on
[GitHub](https://github.com/EnriquePH/energycode/issues), or write to
[energycode.org@gmail.com](mailto:energycode.org@gmail.com).

### How it is built

The site is made with [Quarto](https://quarto.org). Code cells run on R and
Python (Jupyter), and the site is deployed to Netlify. The full source is
available on [GitHub](https://github.com/EnriquePH/energycode).
